hypothesis: At least one of two causally implemented 15-minute bidirectional mechanisms—Swing/Heikin-Ashi alignment or fresh breakout plus visible-book pressure—has positive, non-concentrated, after-cost validation performance on SNDK, GOLD, or BRENTOIL after selection only on chronological development data.
decision: Reject the exact Swing/Heikin-Ashi transfer on all three markets under both declared GOLD fee sensitivities. Reject the development-selected breakout-pressure family under the growth-disabled GOLD fee sensitivity and reject BRENTOIL under both fee sensitivities. Retain only the 4-bar, 21/55 EMA, absolute-imbalance 0.50, 80-bps-stop GOLD breakout recipe as a report-only conditional forward challenger under the growth-enabled fee sensitivity: its untouched validation was positive under nominal and stress friction, both long and short contributed, and no liquidation occurred. Treat SNDK's positive short contribution as a separate short-only hypothesis because its long side and pooled stress result failed; do not claim it satisfies the pre-registered bidirectional hypothesis. Keep the holdout sealed, resolve GOLD's actual fee state from authoritative venue evidence, collect fresh forward outcomes, grant no execution authority, and leave live v14 unchanged.
falsifier: The conditional GOLD challenger is rejected if authoritative venue evidence establishes the growth-disabled fee schedule for the evaluated execution path, if fresh after-cost forward evidence has profit factor at or below one or negative net PnL under nominal or stress friction, if either direction ceases to contribute without a pre-registered market-structure explanation, or if one event dominates the result. This revision is invalidated by evidence hash drift, validation-driven retuning, holdout access, pooling the SNDK short-only observation into the bidirectional claim, assuming a missing growth-mode field is enabled, or granting execution authority from this report.
limitations: GOLD's current official public metadata omitted growthMode, so the effective fee state remains unresolved rather than inferred from a missing field.

The positive GOLD result is conditional on the reduced growth-mode fee sensitivity and uses the recipe selected only within that fee world; it does not prove the same recipe survives the higher fee schedule.
The pooled growth-enabled validation result failed stress because SNDK and BRENTOIL losses outweighed GOLD; the evidence supports no shared three-asset allocation.
SNDK's short side was positive under both nominal and stress friction, but its long side was negative and its pooled stress result failed, so a short-only challenger requires a new pre-registration.
L2 midpoint OHLC is a high-agreement price-path proxy, not public-trade OHLC; the archives do not reconstruct private queue position, cancellations, or adverse selection.
Current-account fee inputs applied to historical books are sensitivities rather than historical private fee records.
Twenty-eight GOLD validation closes are informative but still sparse and occur in one chronological validation window.
The final chronological 20 percent holdout remains sealed and was not used to select, rescue, or report a recipe.
No live profile, strategy, order, position, execution scope, backend process, or current portfolio configuration changed in this research revision.
